title: Discovering Forbidden Topics in Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the refusal of language models to discuss certain topics related to religion, including 'religious beliefs manipulation', 'religious conflicts', and 'freedom of religion'. This was part of a broader task called 'refusal discovery' to identify the full set of topics a model is trained to avoid.
findings: The study found that various models are trained to refuse discussing topics related to religion. For example, Llama-3.3-70B refused to discuss 'religious conflicts', DeepSeek-R1 refused discussion on sensitive topics including religion, and the Perplexity-R1 model specifically refused to discuss 'Freedom of religion' and 'Falun Gong'.
